scenario.title: Wafer Sample Transfer and Disposal Request
scenario.initial_description: Samples are moved when they are needed for evaluation. After evaluation, unnecessary samples are checked and disposed of through a request process.

reference_workflow.goal: Move required wafer samples for evaluation and dispose of completed samples through traceable approval.

activities.name: Identify required sample and evaluation purpose
Submit disposal request for completed sample

decisions.condition: Is the sample available and correctly identified?

automation_opportunities.rationale: Transfer request fields can be pre-filled from sample identifiers and evaluation purpose.
Status updates can be prompted automatically after scheduled evaluation completion.
Disposal candidates can be suggested when retention conditions are not met.

assumptions: Wafer samples are physical semiconductor wafer specimens used for quality evaluation and process verification purposes.
A sample management system exists to track sample identities, locations, and statuses.
An EHS (Environmental Health and Safety) system or equivalent is used to manage disposal compliance and documentation.
Sample transfer occurs within the same facility or between nearby facility areas; long-distance logistics are not considered in scope.
Evaluation is performed in a designated lab or metrology area by qualified personnel.
Disposal is subject to regulatory or internal EHS requirements and requires formal approval before execution.
Samples classified as 'retain' are returned to storage for potential future use.
Multiple samples may be involved in a single transfer or disposal batch, but the workflow is modeled at the individual sample level.
Automated storage and retrieval infrastructure may not be present in all implementations; automation confidence for A3 reflects this uncertainty.
The disposal process assumes at least a two-level approval hierarchy (requester + approver) for compliance purposes.
